## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.2.7

Reset View restores the Recorded Drives layout, sorting, and scroll position without changing the workbook. Recorded Drives stays scrollable while Terminal is running; editing is still held until Terminal closes.

Terminal input and workbook path text are vertically centered in their fields. Footer text and buttons share one vertical line. Copy Path confirms the action on the button for one second, both in the main window and in the Finish dialog.

Drive identity reads now pulse slowly in dark blue. Errors appear red, and saved records appear green briefly before the status returns to waiting for another drive.
